name: Kreech Redcap
source_profile:
Boss Kreech Redcap (CE)

Kreech Redcap is a cunning and vicious goblin warlord whose authority rests on personal intimidation and the promise of easy plunder. He delights in elaborate humiliations and frequently changes his plans without warning, much to the frustration of his lieutenants. Kreech regards Cadorian settlers as both prey and a convenient source of weapons, livestock, and supplies.

However, Kreech Redcap is not the name of a single goblin, but an inherited title borne by successive leaders of the Rattleknife Mob. The tradition stretches back generations, and the true names of most former Redcaps have been forgotten. When a Kreech Redcap is slain, the strongest surviving goblin of the Mob claims leadership, assumes the name, and dons the distinctive blood-red cap from which the title originates. The transition is seldom peaceful, as ambitious lieutenants frequently contest who among them is strongest, with the matter typically settled through violence, with the victor often soaking the cap once more in the blood of the slain Kreech Redcap.

To outsiders, this peculiar tradition has given Kreech Redcap an almost legendary reputation. Stories of his death are common, yet inevitably another goblin bearing the same name emerges to lead the Rattleknives.
